title: MultiGapCloze Question Schema
description: Passage with multiple gaps, each accepting free text with multiple valid answers (Cambridge FCE/CAE Reading Part 2 - Open Cloze)

passage.description: Text with numbered @@@1, @@@2, etc. marking gaps (1-based)

gapAcceptedAnswers.description: Dictionary: gap number (1-based, as string) → array of accepted answers. IMPORTANT: accepted answers should not contain commas (,) or colons (:). Some consuming applications encode multi-gap submissions as 'gap:answer,gap:answer' on the wire, in which case any comma or colon inside an answer can be silently truncated during scoring. Other punctuation is discouraged since MultiGapCloze is typically a vocabulary/grammar exercise (single words or short phrases); apostrophes (e.g., don't) and hyphens (e.g., well-known) are fine.

allowPartialCredit.description: Award partial credit for some correct answers
